subject: general
question: Where was the first cement plant located in India in the year 1904?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first cement plant in India was established in the year **1904**.
 
• This plant was located in **Chennai**, which was** then known as Madras**.
 
• The establishment of this plant marked the beginning of the cement industry in India, which has grown significantly over the years.
 
• Chennai, being a **major port city**, provided the necessary infrastructure and logistics for the cement industry to flourish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The cement industry in India has since become one of the largest in the world, contributing significantly to the country's infrastructure development.
 
• Modern cement plants in India are equipped with state-of-the-art technology and adhere to strict environmental standards.
 
• The growth of the cement industry has also led to the development of related industries and the creation of numerous job opportunities.
 
• Today, India is not only self-sufficient in cement production but also exports cement to various countries.
